lean.fidelity_note: The formal statement retains (5.19)–(5.22), including strict positive coupling, the support assumptions, the initial-value term and the factor $\lambda$ on the pressure. Its scope changes in both directions: part (i) requires fields smooth on all of $[0,T]$, while the paper allows fields supplied only on $[t_0,T]$; the parent pressure may be more general, and the central normalization is only $0<\gamma\le1$, rather than $\max\gamma=1$. It also fixes one admissible envelope. Part (ii) bounds every solution satisfying the transverse equation and normalization; existence and uniqueness are supplied by separate results. A separate formal estimate treats fields defined only on the active interval, but this does not change the scope of the numbered statement itself.
